# Nabee Compression Socks

> Nabee Compression Socks creates fun, colorful graduated compression socks (20-30mmHg) designed for everyday heroes including nurses, healthcare workers, and anyone seeking stylish leg health solutions.

Founded by Brian Park, Nabee specializes in making medical-grade compression socks that don't sacrifice style. The brand uses premium materials like Nylon and Lycra, with collections ranging from solid colors to fun patterns like Shamrock and Hearts, and has been featured in Yahoo Lifestyle.

## Key Topics

- Graduated Compression (20-30mmHg)
